title: ObjectiveCertificate
description: Mathematical evidence gating objective submission. See 02-modelling.md §4.7.
$comment: Amended 2026-08-18 (W5, custom objectives), when this contract first met a generated counterpart. Three resolutions, each the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): (1) the findings moved into `result`, because certification runs in pricing-core and ADR-0001 forbids it an id, a clock or a job — `CertificateResult` is what it returns and this shape is what the platform persists around it; (2) the checks are named `analytic_vs_numeric_*`, not `symbolic_vs_numeric_*`: with expression objectives deferred to Phase 2 (OQ-MODEL-1) nothing is symbolic, and the derivatives compared are the hand-written analytic ones; `branch_discontinuity` joins the list as a ninth named check (FR-MODEL-69); (3) the failing status is `failed`, matching CheckStatus and the `failed` overall, rather than `fail`. The one place the contract was right and the code was not is `sampling.n_points`: the model admitted a grid of 1, and now carries this floor.

job_id.description: The certification Job, where one ran. Null for a certificate recorded outside the job path.

invariants: overall is derived from the checks and enforced: any 'failed' check fails the certificate, any 'warn' or 'violated' makes it 'certified_with_findings'
convexity status 'violated' requires the objective to declare a hessian_strategy and escalates to two approvers (FR-MODEL-43)
